title: Among patients who had both an abnormal anti-SSA result and a total cholest
question: Among patients who had both an abnormal anti-SSA result and a total cholesterol level above 200 in any laboratory test, find the one with the earliest birthday. For this patient, return their sex, and the earliest date on which they met both laboratory conditions.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P."XCL_058" AS patient_id
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE L."XCL_053" NOT IN ('negative', '0')
      AND L."XCL_026" > 200
)
SELECT P."XCL_059" AS sex,
       MIN(L."XCL_015") AS earliest_date
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN qualifying AS Q ON P."XCL_058" = Q.patient_id
WHERE L."XCL_053" NOT IN ('negative', '0')
  AND L."XCL_026" > 200
GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
ORDER BY P."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1;

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P."XCL_058" AS patient_id
    FROM Patient AS P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE L."XCL_053" NOT IN ('negative', '0')
      AND L."XCL_026" > 200
)
SELECT P."XCL_059" AS sex,
       MIN(L."XCL_015") AS earliest_date
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN qualifying AS Q ON P."XCL_058" = Q.patient_id
WHERE L."XCL_053" NOT IN ('negative', '0')
  AND L."XCL_026" > 200
GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
ORDER BY P."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
